note.zh: 在 Open Code 中以 DeepSeek V4 Pro（最高思考强度）一次生成，未修复。包含 Perlin 噪声地形、WASD 第一人称操控、15 种方块类型、程序化像素纹理、7 种神话幻想建筑（巨石阵、废墟高塔、漂浮空岛、世界之树、龙骨遗骸、遗忘神殿、秘境传送门）。
note.en: One-shot by DeepSeek V4 Pro in Open Code with max thinking effort, unmodified. Features Perlin noise terrain, WASD first-person controls, 15 block types, procedural pixel textures, 7 mythic fantasy structures (Stone Circle, Ruined Tower, Floating Islands, World Tree, Dragon Skeleton, Forgotten Temple, Mystic Portal).
